newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to disburse $67 mln in family subsidies.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to disburse $67 mln in family subsidies.

text.p: The Venezuelan government will disburse 27.20 billion bolivars (about $67 million) Saturday in family subsidies to benefit nearly three million impoverished people, Family Minister Carlos Altimari said.
The money, corresponding to the months of March and April, will be paid in cheques of 9,600 bolivars ($20 dollars) each to identified family heads, he said in a press release.

Analysts say these subsidies, to be handed out throughout the year, partly explain why belt-tightening measures adopted by the government over the past year as part of an IMF-backed economic adjustment plan have triggered no major social unrest.
